_comment: #5935 regression: a UC Bostad Värdeutlåtande / Småhus whose banner OCR'd with the UC logo misread as 'Oo' between the two tokens. The old '\s+' join could not span it, so _is_datavardering_uc_smahus returned False and the document extracted 0 fields even though ocr_used was True. Synthetic — no client document or PII; the 'Oo' between the banner tokens reproduces the real damage from Datavärdering (2).pdf.
